body.text: Start time (date -u): 2026-11-04T19:25:03Z. Experiment D2S-PLUG-7. Hard deadline 2026-11-05T03:25:03Z. Stage 1 reconstruction will last at least until 2026-11-04T20:25:03Z before any training simulation is built. Initial understanding: sequentially grasp white then black charger from the right, lift and reorient each with blades upward, transport left, release upright and withdraw. I will quantify observed phases, poses, contacts and uncertainties from this demonstration, record the reconstruction and strict evidence-based criteria, then build physics and train a deployable closed-loop PPO policy. No prior-run records will be consulted.

Reconstruction minute 5: all 436 frames segmented; HaWoR detects right hand on frames 37–396 (360 frames). Frame-0 SAM3 masks agree visually with both chargers. Camera geometry is ill-conditioned: unconstrained rounded-corner PnP fits f=391px (RMS4.57px), whereas the MoGe prior across three frames is 1036–1074px; a combined geometric/prior estimate is 931px. Absolute background homography decomposition produced implausible camera translations up to 0.62m and is rejected. I am replacing it with sequential background rotation estimation, labeling unestimated camera translation as a limitation. Object silhouette tracks are running independently, then will be reconciled with the common tabletop and contact phases.

Reconstruction minute 15: raw silhouette tracking gives high overlap but permits physically inconsistent depths and a wrong white-plug blade orientation. A common support-height search with explicit side-lying and blade-up endpoints reaches mean endpoint IoU 0.857 and resting objects drift only 0.004mm in 1s of gravity simulation. Default MANO fitting yields mask IoU 0.8274 and contact-within-10mm share 0.861; stronger contact/penetration terms with fixed scale preserve IoU 0.8273 and reach contact share 1.0 (max penetration 0.5mm by the fit scorer). Whole-scene anatomical, intersection and continuity validation is still pending. A separate camera-translation proposal inferred from the stationary charger gives only 27mm maximum horizontal motion, unlike the rejected homography estimate; it will be checked before adoption.

body.text: Reconstruction refinement: nearest-point contact is insufficient: the default whole-scene validator measured zero thumb-contact fraction and 58.9% finger self-intersection. I copied only the provided handlib Python sources into my workspace (installed package unchanged) and added separately weighted thumb/opposing-distal-finger surface contact, a contact-point opposition term, and distal-finger capsule separation. This remains the HaWoR-initialized MANO optimization method, with explicit local extensions justified by its failed anatomical checks. The bounded 27mm camera-translation proposal is now being tested with newly generated fit inputs. Reconstruction v1 remains preserved in research/recon_v1 and recorded as r0004.

body.text: At reconstruction minute28, explicit physical constraints improve opposed-grasp support to100% of evaluated contact frames for both plugs and reduce whole-scene object penetration to0.47mm white/1.36mm black. Finger self-intersection falls from58.9% to15%, but still fails. Supported hand frames fall to294 because the unchanged image-support rule rejects poor fits; mean mask IoU is0.698. A mesh audit shows prior capsule radii were too small:95th-percentile skin-to-distal-centerline distances are14.7mm thumb,11.6 index,10.5 middle,10.7 ring and10.0 little. I am using these measured radii to refine separation and increasing the table constraint. This is a documented image/physics tradeoff, with all earlier versions retained.

Reconstruction minute32: measured-radius separation eliminates all finger-pair intersections in the independent every-other-frame audit (180 checked frames), with mask IoU0.7026, scorer penetration0.3mm and contact share1.0. Whole-scene validation will follow. Local object-pose refinement is accepted only after hard rasterization and support checks: black lift/turn cared IoU improves0.655 to0.862; white also improves. Corrections are bounded to20deg and20mm, temporally smoothed, and object poses are fixed after observed table touchdown rather than drifting until release. Every object remains on or above the table. Hand fitting is now being alternated against these refined object trajectories. Calibration sensitivity is large globally:128 noisy/dimension-perturbed refits give75.9mm combined absolute-position sensitivity and a5.35deg95th-percentile gravity-direction change; this is explicitly a sensitivity analysis, not a calibrated posterior.

body.text: Reference feasibility calculation before simulation: maximum reconstructed wrist translation speed1.053m/s is below the2.5m/s executed-target limit. One angular transient reaches7.12rad/s; applying the6rad/s target limiter produces only2.14deg maximum lag on supported frames, well within the proposed25deg median wrist criterion. A hand-only point-mass acceleration/gravity estimate peaks22.28N against the30N wrist force cap; this omits contacts and finger dynamics and must still be checked in physics. Specified charger dimensions/COM give tipping angles24.89/24.90deg, motivating a strict10deg final upright tolerance. At inferred friction0.65 the white charger needs about0.566N opposing normal force per side for static support. No training simulation has been built; the full reconstruction hour ends20:25:03Z.

body.text: Stage1 ended at2026-11-04T20:25:03Z after the full60minutes from19:25:03Z; output preparation was complete before the deadline. Five reconstruction versions are recorded; selected version5/r0012 is formally VALID and all10 evaluated quality checks PASS. It supports357 of360 detected hand frames;139–141 remain failed fits, and occlusion/symmetry/global-depth uncertainty stay explicit. No training simulation or policy has been built. The criteria are finalized from measured motion, physical reasoning and stated uncertainty, and will now be recorded before simulation. Remaining hard deadline2026-11-05T03:25:03Z.

PPO iteration1 will learn a closed-loop26D residual around the physically retargeted demonstration. The untrained replay baseline fails both transfers and exceeds a pinky abduction speed limit at9.59s, so its open-loop motion is insufficient. Dense object-position/axis, physical opposed-contact, lift, settling and wrist/finger tracking rewards will encourage a secure pinch before carrying. Reference reset starts at pregrasp/placement frames are annealed to full starts; no welds, scripted object forces or privileged observations are used. Actor/critic observe148 deployable features including noisy proprioception, object states, previous targets, and reference constants indexed only by time. All RL uses PPO. Verification uses recorded criteria1 and20 held-out full-start episodes.

body.text: Elapsed3h05m. Sim6 transfer currently has frequent hardware terminations (up to39% in a recent rolling200-episode training window), despite safe zero-residual baseline/initialization. This is not a passing result. Diagnose commanded posture/self-contact and observation-statistic transfer. Hypotheses: old two-finger residuals conflict with new middle-finger contact, and rapid RMS updates alter a transferred network function outside PPO clipping. Prepare smaller nonessential residuals, gentle encoder-based nominal torque-demand shaping (full hardware braking retained), deterministic pose-derived features, and function-preserving first-layer compensation when normalization statistics change. These use only allowed noisy encoders/object states/constants; no contact/force observations will be introduced.

alignment.definition: Translate reconstruction so table z=0 and initial object mean x=.1m; +Y remains left. The+50mm Y shift puts both initial centers right and both final centers left; no per-episode evaluation alignment is fitted.

wrist.controller: 1kHz Cartesian impedance, Kp_lin2000,Kd_lin60,Kp_rot20,Kd_rot0.4; own-hand gravity and COM moment compensation; force norm30N, torque norm2Nm. Executed pose targets updated500Hz with2.5m/s and6rad/s rate limits and matching finite-difference feedforward.
wrist.software_governor: Same encoder-only500Hz target-speed governor as sim6; hardware impedance and2.5m/s,6rad/s maximum unchanged.

fingers.controller: Exact hardware joint-specific PD at1kHz; torque saturated at each published effort.20 position commands clipped to limits at500Hz; zero optional velocity targets.
fingers.armature: Vendor table:5e-4 for thumbCMC and four MCPflex,2e-4 others.
fingers.speed_rules: Actual q/qd/applied torque checked every1ms, including contact-backdriven motion. A violating trial terminates; no qvel-state clipping is used.
fingers.target_shaper: 500Hz software encoder-based brake before unchanged1kHz hardware PD: after3rad/s ordinary target slew, b=clip((abs(qd_noisy)/vmax-.45)/.20,0,1); q_target=clip((1-b)*q_target+b*(q_noisy-.12sign(qd_noisy)),URDF limits). Position noise.002rad, velocity noise.05rad/s; no contact/force input. Actual qvel is never clipped. Normal motion: nominal PD demand from noisy encoders is bounded through position-target error to15% of effort for long MCPflex and40% elsewhere. This changes software targets; hardware effort/PD gains remain exact. The full emergency brake overrides this gentle bound. Ring/pinky neural residual amplitude.03rad, first12 joints.35rad.

reward_terms.name: opposed_contact
reward_terms.formula: Active:0.6 positional opposition else0.1 any hand;0.8 balanced force/0.6N with opposed normals;0.4exp(-pad-bodySDF^2/.02^2) each thumb/index/middle. Before supported upright left, add0.8*clip(min(three normal forces)/.3N)*clip(norm(cross(index-thumb,middle-thumb))/.0004m2), with opposition and three contacts. Once supported upright left, replace accumulated contact term by0.15*term-0.6*sum(three normal forces)+0.4 anyhand before release-due or-0.4 anyhand after. Always subtract0.15sum min(10,relu(force-4N)). Supported-before-release-due: add max_over_thumb,index,middle exp(-((bodySDF(padskin)-.0015)/.01)^2) to encourage gentle last contact. Release-ready additionally needs phase>=205 white or>=373 black. Release-due requires phase>=205white/373black and span>=3.6white/3.3black, without upper bound. Actual settled/milestone/terminal eligibility retains upper duration bounds through release-ready.

reward_terms.name: object_position
reward_terms.formula: sum_o weight*exp(-||p-p_ref||^2/0.035^2); weight2 active,.35 otherwise

reward_terms.name: object_axis
reward_terms.formula: Active:2.5*(clip(dot(actual blade axis,reference blade axis),-1,1)+1)/2+2exp(-angle²/.35²); inactive:.15exp(-angle²/.5²).

reward_terms.name: wrist_tracking
reward_terms.formula: Against unmodified human mount trajectory: .45exp(-position_error^2/.055^2)+.45exp(-SO3_error^2/.45^2)-3(relu(position_error-.08)/.03)^2-2(relu(SO3_error-1.0471975512)/.3)^2

reward_terms.name: finger_tracking
reward_terms.formula: exp(-mean(q-q_ref)^2/.16)

reward_terms.name: opposed_contact
reward_terms.formula: Active:0.6 positional opposition else0.1 any hand;0.8 balanced force/0.6N with opposed normals;0.4exp(-pad-bodySDF^2/.02^2) each thumb/index/middle. Before supported upright left, add0.8*clip(min(three normal forces)/.3N)*clip(norm(cross(index-thumb,middle-thumb))/.0004m2), with opposition and three contacts. Once supported upright left, replace accumulated contact term by0.15*term-0.6*sum(three normal forces)+0.4 anyhand before release-due or-0.4 anyhand after. Always subtract0.15sum min(10,relu(force-4N)). Supported-before-release-due: add max_over_thumb,index,middle exp(-((bodySDF(padskin)-.0015)/.01)^2) to encourage gentle last contact. Release-ready additionally needs phase>=205 white or>=373 black. Release-due requires phase>=205white/373black and span>=3.6white/3.3black, without upper bound. Actual settled/milestone/terminal eligibility retains upper duration bounds through release-ready.

reward_terms.name: lift_height
reward_terms.formula: Active phase100<=f<155white or280<=f<360black:2clip(bottom/(.015white,.035black),0,1)*(.3+.7exp(-tilt²/.45²)); after interval if left:exp(-bottom²/.005²)exp(-tilt²/.3²).

reward_terms.name: settled
reward_terms.formula: Per-object upright left/base supported/velocity small/no hand AND release-ready. Release-ready: first sustained opposed grasp to final touch span3.6-5.8s white,3.3-5.4s black; reference-initialized preplaced objects exempt during curriculum.

reward_terms.name: milestones
reward_terms.formula: First settled/release-ready+8; first bottom>1cm+2; one-off-20 for first supporting table contact on right after an upright-air sample. One-off-20 if bottom>5mm or rotation from actual initial orientation>10deg before100ms stable opposed grasp during active phase; stable grasp flag latches once achieved.

reward_terms.name: action_smoothness
reward_terms.formula: -.02mean(filtered_action^2)-.03mean(action_change^2)

reward_terms.name: joint_speed
reward_terms.formula: -mean((qd/(.8*published_speed))^4)

reward_terms.name: ordered_rest
reward_terms.formula: Before white first settled:-2min(4,relu(blackXYdrift-.005)/.01); active plug:-2clip((y-.13)/.04,0,1)*relu(blade_tilt-.34906585), no tilt upper cap.

reward_terms.name: penetration
reward_terms.formula: -min(4,(max_[redacted]-.003)^2/.003^2) above3mm

reward_terms.name: terminal
reward_terms.formula: -2000 hardware violation;-25 drop/nonfinite;-100 timeout without stable goal;+1000 both settled/release-ready continuously1.6s (training goal, full criteria evaluated separately).

reward_terms.name: finger_tracking
reward_terms.formula: exp(-mean(q-q_ref)^2/.16)

reward_terms.name: opposed_contact
reward_terms.formula: Active:0.6 positional opposition else0.1 any hand;0.8 balanced force/0.6N with opposed normals;0.4exp(-pad-bodySDF^2/.02^2) each thumb/index/middle. Before supported upright left, add0.8*clip(min(three normal forces)/.3N)*clip(norm(cross(index-thumb,middle-thumb))/.0004m2), with opposition and three contacts. Once supported upright left, replace accumulated contact term by0.15*term-0.6*sum(three normal forces)+0.4 anyhand before release-due or-0.4 anyhand after. Always subtract0.15sum min(10,relu(force-4N)). Supported-before-release-due: add max_over_thumb,index,middle exp(-((bodySDF(padskin)-.0015)/.01)^2) to encourage gentle last contact. Release-ready additionally needs phase>=205 white or>=373 black. Release-due requires phase>=205white/373black and span>=3.6white/3.3black, without upper bound. Actual settled/milestone/terminal eligibility retains upper duration bounds through release-ready.

body.change_from_version3: Exact self-collision penalties fix index-middle interference; anatomically staggered contacts; task-free axial roll adapted while preserving blade axis and translation. Reference-state resets moved to supported pregrasp poses with geometric rejection. Baseline0/20 full tasks but occasional black lifts;20/20 hardware-safe.
body.change_from_version4: Three-finger geometry reference for rotational control; encoder brake begins at45% rather than55% of velocity limit (full at65%). Hardware PD/gains/limits and physical contact model unchanged. Training reward increases airborne uprightness and axis tracking, discourages excessive squeeze/premature carry, and measures wrist tracking against the unmodified human reference. Policy observes only deployable data; human reference is constant task data, forces remain reward-only.
body.change_from_version5: Same three-contact geometry reference as sim5. Wider neural wrist rotation residual(.55rad/component), fixed200ms reference pause at frame205, and encoder-based wrist target-speed governor. Rewards explicitly favor3 noncollinear contacts, lighter placed contact and release after minimum grasp duration. Human orientation soft penalty begins60deg. Hardware PD/gains/limits/contact physics unchanged; all finger velocities remain checked each1ms.
body.change_from_version6: 193 deployable derived observations and29 Gaussian outputs (3 extra angular channels initialized zero); unused ring/pinky residuals reduced to.03rad. Gentle nominal encoder-based PD-demand target shaping, with full hardware braking retained. Pose-gated reference progress permits up to1.3s additional turn practice for each object before carry; clock observes only object poses. PPO uses function-preserving normalization compensation for unclipped inputs and optional Huber critic loss. Hardware failures receive-2000; premature supporting contact on the right receives a one-off-20. Original black contact arrangement retained after mirrored alternative reduced lift rate and used more wrist orientation tolerance.
body.change_from_version13: Fix runaway soft-sequencing target: correction at most50mm relative to uncorrected wristtarget and only while object-wrist distance<220mm. Goalbonus20000 only with no hardware/drop/nonfinite and maxpenetration<=3mm; hardwarepenalty-20000. RestarthPPO from retained demonstrationBC initialization, not unstable13weights. body.text: DirectBC/PPO14 stillfails0/20 fullstarts. New15 consolidates ownPPO7white/ownPPO9black learned experts. Diagnostics: source9black firstupright-table phases345-364 in16/20, usually stillhandcontact. Restore original7robotreference/white timing. Afterblackgrasp holdphase305 for350ms while moving90mmright; continue learned turn with90mmYoffset, then hold365, lift45mm250ms,carryoffsettozero600ms,lower200ms,releasephase385. All motion through wristimpedance and real contacts. Canonical policy features translate hand/black poses/velocities by known commandedoffsets, fixedownsource9clock; actualstate/contacts/verifier remainphysical. This is a table-assisted/rightward-excursion variation and may fail strictwrist/timing criteria; no relaxation. Zero-networkbase recorded. Fine-tune black withPPO, preserve learnedwhite.

scene.robot: Wuji Hand2.2 right, exact URDF links/inertias/masses and20 named joints;33 frames,27 mass-bearing links; total0.6878kg.
scene.objects: Exact provided body dimensions, blades, masses and2mm COM offsets; beveled Blender visual bodies and sharp box collision bodies/blades. Box-estimated inertia; inferred friction.
scene.collision_filter: Vendor fixed-link/neighbor overlaps excluded for URDF graph distance<=2; other physical hand contacts retained.

reference.retargeting: Three physical fingertip contacts: thumb body+/-Y face15mm toward USB end; index opposing face20mm toward blades; middle opposing face5mm toward USB. Exact convex self-collision, table/object penalties. Object path/blade axis from reconstruction5, axial roll adapted as sim4. Vertical approach and2mm pad compression apply to all3 fingers. Other joint targets retain optimized poses. Two-contact full-pad-orientation alternative was tested and rejected for larger IK errors; not used.

alignment.definition: Translate reconstruction so table z=0 and initial object mean x=.1m; +Y remains left. The+50mm Y shift puts both initial centers right and both final centers left; no per-episode evaluation alignment is fitted.

reference.runtime_use: Restored exact7bank, not11-14retarget. Referenceq plus learned residuals for all fingers. Originalthree-contact kinematic reference has known object overlaps up to about10mm; it is a target only, actual physical rollouts and1kHz penetrationcriterion decide validity. Human/objectreconstruction5 and fixed scene alignment unchanged.

wrist.type: Unconstrained6DoF free joint; no workspace box or pose constraint.
wrist.controller: 1kHz Cartesian impedance, Kp_lin2000,Kd_lin60,Kp_rot20,Kd_rot0.4; own-hand gravity and COM moment compensation; force norm30N, torque norm2Nm. Executed pose targets updated500Hz with2.5m/s and6rad/s rate limits and matching finite-difference feedforward.
wrist.software_governor: Same encoder-only500Hz target-speed governor as sim6; hardware impedance and2.5m/s,6rad/s maximum unchanged.

fingers.controller: Exact hardware joint-specific PD at1kHz; torque saturated at each published effort.20 position commands clipped to limits at500Hz; zero optional velocity targets.
fingers.armature: Vendor table:5e-4 for thumbCMC and four MCPflex,2e-4 others.
fingers.speed_rules: Actual q/qd/applied torque checked every1ms, including contact-backdriven motion. A violating trial terminates; no qvel-state clipping is used.
fingers.target_shaper: 500Hz software encoder-based brake before unchanged1kHz hardware PD: after3rad/s ordinary target slew, b=clip((abs(qd_noisy)/vmax-.45)/.20,0,1); q_target=clip((1-b)*q_target+b*(q_noisy-.12sign(qd_noisy)),URDF limits). Position noise.002rad, velocity noise.05rad/s; no contact/force input. Actual qvel is never clipped. Normal motion: nominal PD demand from noisy encoders is bounded through position-target error to15% of effort for long MCPflex and40% elsewhere. This changes software targets; hardware effort/PD gains remain exact. The full emergency brake overrides this gentle bound. Ring/pinky neural residual amplitude.03rad, first12 joints.35rad.

episode.action: 44 Gaussian outputs: original29 residual outputs, plus12 first-three-finger residuals(.65rad*tanh) and3 angular residuals(.50rad*tanh). Legacy wrist translation.04, angular.35+.20, first12finger.35,last8finger.03,80ms500Hz filter, unchanged1kHz full hardware PD, same7gentle encoder-only governor. No object attachments or direct object forces.
termination: both unsupported upright left and settled for1.6s (training terminal goal; full recorded criteria evaluated separately)
episode.reference_clock: White exactly restores actual7implementation:13420deg/8mm gate,100ms clearance milestone, actual timeout2.6s and205pause.4s (earlier7text incorrectly claimed1.3/.2). Blackprelift279.25; no326gate. At305pause.35s and move wrist target90mm right smoothly. Continue canonical black pose turn to365 while shiftedright. At365wait for up20deg50ms or.25s; raise target45mm over.25s; hold until actual object up20deg,bottom>8mm for60ms. Then carry90mmleft over.6s, lower45mmover.2s, jumpcanonical385 andwithdraw. All commands pass through identical free-wrist impedance/rate/force limits; actual object remains free. Successful grasp/lift/carry/release timing and human wrist similarity independently checked by originalcriteria1.
episode.training_goal_gate: Full37 minimum/maximum grasp spans, releasephase205white373black andphysicalroughgoal unchanged; no held-state reset exemptions are used in15.

body.text: 03:16 UTC, 59 minutes remain until the extended 04:15 deadline. Sim15 is recorded as r0104 before PPO. Direct BC plus PPO in14 failed to grasp either object, so I return to my strongest PPO7 white behavior and PPO9 black behavior, freeze the white expert, and train black residuals around a right-side table-assisted turn followed by a physical re-lift/carry. New canonical observation features describe only allowed state and known controller history. Zero-output baseline is0/20; this is a residual PPO experiment, not a scripted success claim. reward_terms.name: object_position
reward_terms.formula: sum_o weight*exp(-||p-p_ref||^2/0.035^2); weight2 active,.35 otherwise

reward_terms.name: object_axis
reward_terms.formula: Active:2.5*(clip(dot(actual blade axis,reference blade axis),-1,1)+1)/2+2exp(-angle²/.35²); inactive:.15exp(-angle²/.5²).

reward_terms.name: wrist_tracking
reward_terms.formula: Physical wrist to unchanged human wrist arrays, with fixed training phase map declared in sim15. Black:.45exp(-position_error²/.055²)+.45exp(-SO3_error²/.45²)-min(4,3(relu(position_error-.08)/.03)²)-min(4,2(relu(SO3_error-1.0471975512)/.3)²). White:1.5exp(-position_error²/.055²)+1.5exp(-SO3_error²/.45²)-min(4,8(relu(position_error-.055)/.03)²)-min(4,4(relu(SO3_error-.70)/.3)²).

reward_terms.name: finger_tracking
reward_terms.formula: exp(-mean(q-q_ref)^2/.16)

reward_terms.name: opposed_contact
reward_terms.formula: Active:0.6 positional opposition else0.1 any hand;0.8 balanced force/0.6N with opposed normals;0.4exp(-pad-bodySDF^2/.02^2) each thumb/index/middle. Before supported upright left, add0.8*clip(min(three normal forces)/.3N)*clip(norm(cross(index-thumb,middle-thumb))/.0004m2), with opposition and three contacts. Once supported upright left, replace accumulated contact term by0.15*term-0.6*sum(three normal forces)+0.4 anyhand before release-due or-0.4 anyhand after. Always subtract0.15sum min(10,relu(force-4N)). Supported-before-release-due: add max_over_thumb,index,middle exp(-((bodySDF(padskin)-.0015)/.01)^2) to encourage gentle last contact. Release-ready additionally needs phase>=205 white or>=373 black. Release-due requires phase>=205white/373black and span>=3.6white/3.3black, without upper bound. Actual settled/milestone/terminal eligibility retains upper duration bounds through release-ready.

reward_terms.name: lift_height
reward_terms.formula: Active phase100<=f<155white or280<=f<360black:2clip(bottom/(.015white,.035black),0,1)*(.3+.7exp(-tilt²/.45²)); after interval if left:exp(-bottom²/.005²)exp(-tilt²/.3²).

reward_terms.name: settled
reward_terms.formula: Per-object upright left/base supported/velocity small/no hand AND release-ready. Release-ready: first sustained opposed grasp to final touch span3.6-5.8s white,3.3-5.4s black; reference-initialized preplaced objects exempt during curriculum.

reward_terms.name: milestones
reward_terms.formula: First settled/release-ready+8; first bottom>1cm+2; one-off-20 for first supporting table contact on right after an upright-air sample. One-off-20 if bottom>5mm or rotation from actual initial orientation>10deg before100ms stable opposed grasp during active phase; stable grasp flag latches once achieved.

reward_terms.name: action_smoothness
reward_terms.formula: -.02sum(filtered_action²/group_size)-.03sum(action_change²/group_size); legacy29 and extra15 each separately normalized.

reward_terms.name: joint_speed
reward_terms.formula: -mean((qd/(.8*published_speed))^4)

reward_terms.name: ordered_rest
reward_terms.formula: Before white first settled:-2min(4,relu(blackXYdrift-.005)/.01); active plug:-2clip((y-.13)/.04,0,1)*relu(blade_tilt-.34906585), no tilt upper cap.

reward_terms.name: penetration
reward_terms.formula: -min(4,(max_[redacted]-.003)^2/.003^2) above3mm

reward_terms.name: terminal
reward_terms.formula: -20000 hardware violation;-25 drop/nonfinite;-100 timeout without stable goal;+20000 both settled/release-ready continuously1.6s AND no hardware/drop/nonfinite and maximum physical penetration<=3mm. Full criteria independently checked.

reference.retargeting: Three physical fingertip contacts: thumb body+/-Y face15mm toward USB end; index opposing face20mm toward blades; middle opposing face5mm toward USB. fingers.controller: Exact hardware joint-specific PD at1kHz; torque saturated at each published effort.20 position commands clipped to limits at500Hz; zero optional velocity targets.

fingers.speed_rules: Actual q/qd/applied torque checked every1ms, including contact-backdriven motion. A violating trial terminates; no qvel-state clipping is used.

This changes software targets; hardware effort/PD gains remain exact. The full emergency brake overrides this gentle bound. Ring/pinky neural residual amplitude.03rad, first12 joints.35rad.

reward_terms.name: finger_tracking
reward_terms.formula: exp(-mean(q-q_ref)^2/.16)

reward_terms.name: opposed_contact
reward_terms.formula: Active:0.6 positional opposition else0.1 any hand;0.8 balanced force/0.6N with opposed normals;0.4exp(-pad-bodySDF^2/.02^2) each thumb/index/middle. Before supported upright left, add0.8*clip(min(three normal forces)/.3N)*clip(norm(cross(index-thumb,middle-thumb))/.0004m2), with opposition and three contacts. Once supported upright left, replace accumulated contact term by0.15*term-0.6*sum(three normal forces)+0.4 anyhand before release-due or-0.4 anyhand after. Always subtract0.15sum min(10,relu(force-4N)). Supported-before-release-due: add max_over_thumb,index,middle exp(-((bodySDF(padskin)-.0015)/.01)^2) to encourage gentle last contact. Release-ready additionally needs phase>=205 white or>=373 black. Release-due requires phase>=205white/373black and span>=3.6white/3.3black, without upper bound. Actual settled/milestone/terminal eligibility retains upper duration bounds through release-ready.

reward_terms.name: lift_height
reward_terms.formula: Active phase100<=f<155white or280<=f<360black:2clip(bottom/(.015white,.035black),0,1)*(.3+.7exp(-tilt²/.45²)); after interval if left:exp(-bottom²/.005²)exp(-tilt²/.3²). Also active during black augmentation re-lift/carry stages2/3.

reward_terms.name: settled
reward_terms.formula: Per-object upright left/base supported/velocity small/no hand AND release-ready. Release-ready: first sustained opposed grasp to final touch span3.6-5.8s white,3.3-5.4s black; reference-initialized preplaced objects exempt during curriculum.

reward_terms.name: milestones
reward_terms.formula: First settled/release-ready+8; first bottom>1cm+2; one-off-20 for first supporting table contact on right after an upright-air sample. One-off-20 if bottom>5mm or rotation from actual initial orientation>10deg before100ms stable opposed grasp during active phase; stable grasp flag latches once achieved.

reward_terms.name: action_smoothness
reward_terms.formula: -.02sum(filtered_action²/group_size)-.03sum(action_change²/group_size); legacy29 and extra15 each separately normalized.

reward_terms.name: joint_speed
reward_terms.formula: -mean((qd/(.8*published_speed))^4)

reward_terms.name: ordered_rest
reward_terms.formula: Before white first settled:-2min(4,relu(blackXYdrift-.005)/.01); active plug:-2clip((y-.13)/.04,0,1)*relu(blade_tilt-.34906585), no tilt upper cap.

reward_terms.formula: -min(4,(max_[redacted]-.003)^2/.003^2) above3mm

fingers.controller: Exact hardware joint-specific PD at1kHz; torque saturated at each published effort.20 position commands clipped to limits at500Hz; zero optional velocity targets.

fingers.target_shaper: 500Hz software encoder-based brake before unchanged1kHz hardware PD: after3rad/s ordinary target slew, b=clip((abs(qd_noisy)/vmax-.45)/.20,0,1); q_target=clip((1-b)*q_target+b*(q_noisy-.12sign(qd_noisy)),URDF limits). Normal motion: nominal PD demand from noisy encoders is bounded through position-target error to15% of effort for long MCPflex and40% elsewhere. This changes software targets; hardware effort/PD gains remain exact. The full emergency brake overrides this gentle bound. Ring/pinky neural residual amplitude.03rad, first12 joints.35rad.

body.text:
Final reflection for the extended04:15UTC deadline. Originalstart2026-11-04T19:25:03UTC; provider shutdown killed all processes, so I recovered from retained checkpoints and recorded lost uncheckpointed steps. All new PPO training ended before04:10; the last24experiment was explicitly a zero-update transfer of already PPO-trained experts.

Final own-simulation verification r0162 is FAIL:0/20 full-criteria successes under unchanged criteria1. The selected16prefix reproduces both final upright/settled chargers20/20, all black manipulation checks20/20, hardware and [redacted]s20/20. Eighteen trials meet all criteria except wrist; one white crossing and one white-preservation case also fail. Median trial wrist positionp95 is129.4mm against100mm, and median trial rotation median26.4deg against25deg. A fresh1kHz20-case rerun reproduced every physical state exactly. This is no official evaluation and no real-hardware success.

What worked: VALID reconstruction5 after the full60-minute stage; exact hardware PD/limits with encoder-only target governors; learned PPO grasp/turn experts; frozen expert branches and reduced learning rate to prevent catastrophic forgetting; physical1kHz contact/event audits. The zero-output reference controls never solved the full task. Simple final-standing rewards produced strong partial manipulation but did not establish the demonstrated skill.

What failed: static demonstration BC did not yield full-start grasps; later stronger grip and clearance feedback produced penetration/hardware failures or wrong placement order. White approach retiming improved wrist approach, but black table-assisted turning still differs from human motion. Horizontal reference changes reduced some position errors while degrading grasp robustness. I retained the stronger measured checkpoint instead of relaxing criteria or claiming that standing alone passed.

Next I would distill physical rollouts from the successful PPO grasp experts into a wrist-constrained contact…

Operator extension recorded before resuming research. New continuation starts2026-11-05T06:24:56Z and has a NEW HARD DEADLINE2026-11-05T14:24:56Z, superseding all prior expired deadlines. Training cutoff14:14:56UTC reserves10minutes for final verification/reflection and job shutdown. Persisted research_clock.json and research_state.json updated; prior clock/result preserved. Retain VALID reconstruction5/r0012 and unchanged criteria1; do not restart reconstruction or relax criteria. Retain best16prefix checkpoint (r0117/r0118, finalrepeat r0162), with0/20strictsuccesses,20/20bothstanding,18/20allnon-wristcriteria and nohardwareviolations. Focus on wristfidelity while preserving manipulation. No training/evaluation jobs remain live at restart; resume from retained files. Previous turn classified as progress through completed repeatability evidence and records.

Continuation diagnosis: teacher16 re-collection reproduced all20 physical trajectories exactly. Offline fixed-fingertip IK shows simple linear wrist-to-human interpolation becomes infeasible at several poses; this is not a proof that the criterion is impossible. A planar-only physical reference fit predicts no wrist passes. Next test: offline small rigid hand-and-object frame rotations and horizontal path corrections, constrained by exact table clearance and original object tilt/phase ordering. Relative grasp geometry is preserved in the geometric proposal; inertia/contact changes still require physical PPO rollouts. This is a reference controller retargeting, not post-hoc metric alignment or runtime planning. The final residual network remains PPO-trained, the zero-network base will be reported separately, criteria1/hardware unchanged.

scene.robot: Wuji Hand2.2 right, exact URDF links/inertias/masses and20 named joints;33 frames,27 mass-bearing links; total0.6878kg.
scene.objects: Exact provided body dimensions, blades, masses and2mm COM offsets; beveled Blender visual bodies and sharp box collision bodies/blades. Box-estimated inertia; inferred friction.
scene.collision_filter: Vendor fixed-link/neighbor overlaps excluded for URDF graph distance<=2; other physical hand contacts retained.

reference.retargeting: Three physical fingertip contacts: thumb body+/-Y face15mm toward USB end; index opposing face20mm toward blades; middle opposing face5mm toward USB. Exact convex self-collision, table/object penalties. Object path/blade axis from reconstruction5, axial roll adapted as sim4. Vertical approach and2mm pad compression apply to all3 fingers. Other joint targets retain optimized poses. Two-contact full-pad-orientation alternative was tested and rejected for larger IK errors; not used.

alignment.definition: Translate reconstruction so table z=0 and initial object mean x=.1m; +Y remains left. The+50mm Y shift puts both initial centers right and both final centers left; no per-episode evaluation alignment is fitted.

reference.runtime_use: Retain reconstruction5 human/object arrays and original21robot bank. Add an offline rigid-grasp frame reference fitted on own PPO16teacher case0 and the fixed human wrist reference under criteria1 phase alignment. Lookup gives bounded small rotation and XYZtranslation indexed by source-controller phase/stage/elapsed time. Runtime only interpolates/filters fixed lookup, no optimizer. Physical wrist targets are transformed; objects move only through ordinary contacts. White21base remains, black warp starts afterphase294, fades rotationto0 and XYtranslationto[-40mm,0]duringcarry.
reference.offline_fit: SLSQP static geometry calculation, rotationnorm<=8deg; actual hand/table distance constraint, retain object lowest-point height, avoid premature upright-air event or worsening high tilt. Horizontal wrist fit to unchanged human pose; sourcecase0only, geometric all20diagnostic predictions shown separately. This changes physical reference targets, never fits an evaluation alignment.

wrist.type: Unconstrained6DoF free joint; no workspace box or pose constraint.
wrist.controller: 1kHz Cartesian impedance, Kp_lin2000,Kd_lin60,Kp_rot20,Kd_rot0.4; own-hand gravity and COM moment compensation; force norm30N, torque norm2Nm. Executed pose targets updated500Hz with2.5m/s and6rad/s rate limits and matching finite-difference feedforward.
wrist.software_governor: Same encoder-only500Hz target-speed governor as sim6; hardware impedance and2.5m/s,6rad/s maximum unchanged.

fingers.controller: Exact hardware joint-specific PD at1kHz; torque saturated at each published effort.20 position commands clipped to limits at500Hz; zero optional velocity targets.

reward_terms.name: object_position
reward_terms.formula: sum_o weight*exp(-||p-p_ref||^2/0.035^2); weight2 active,.35 otherwise During blackaugmentation, physical reference target adds[0,-shift_y,lift_z]. Blacktracking target is transformed by the same current fixed-reference frame in25; humanwrist reward remains physical/untransformed.

reward_terms.name: object_axis
reward_terms.formula: Active:2.5*(clip(dot(actual blade axis,reference blade axis),-1,1)+1)/2+2exp(-angle²/.35²); inactive:.15exp(-angle²/.5²). Blacktracking target is transformed by the same current fixed-reference frame in25; humanwrist reward remains physical/untransformed.

reward_terms.name: wrist_tracking
reward_terms.formula: Physical wrist to unchanged human wrist arrays, with fixed training phase map declared in sim15. Black:.45exp(-position_error²/.055²)+.45exp(-SO3_error²/.45²)-min(4,3(relu(position_error-.08)/.03)²)-min(4,2(relu(SO3_error-1.0471975512)/.3)²). White:1.5exp(-position_error²/.055²)+1.5exp(-SO3_error²/.45²)-min(4,8(relu(position_error-.055)/.03)²)-min(4,4(relu(SO3_error-.70)/.3)²).

reward_terms.name: finger_tracking
reward_terms.formula: exp(-mean(q-q_ref)^2/.16)

reward_terms.name: opposed_contact
reward_terms.formula: Active:0.6 positional opposition else0.1 any hand;0.8 balanced force/0.6N with opposed normals;0.4exp(-pad-bodySDF^2/.02^2) each thumb/index/middle. Before supported upright left, add0.8*clip(min(three normal forces)/.3N)*clip(norm(cross(index-thumb,middle-thumb))/.0004m2), with opposition and three contacts. Once supported upright left, replace accumulated contact term by0.15*term-0.6*sum(three normal forces)+0.4 anyhand before release-due or-0.4 anyhand after. Always subtract0.15sum min(10,relu(force-4N)). Supported-before-release-due: add max_over_thumb,index,middle exp(-((bodySDF(padskin)-.0015)/.01)^2) to encourage gentle last contact. Release-ready additionally needs phase>=205 white or>=373 black. Release-due requires phase>=205white/373black and span>=3.6white/3.3black, without upper bound. Actual settled/milestone/terminal eligibility retains upper duration bounds through release-ready.

reward_terms.name: lift_height
reward_terms.formula: Active phase100<=f<155white or280<=f<360black:2clip(bottom/(.015white,.035black),0,1)*(.3+.7exp(-tilt²/.45²)); after interval if left:exp(-bottom²/.005²)exp(-tilt²/.3²). Also active during black augmentation re-lift/carry stages2/3.

reward_terms.name: settled
reward_terms.formula: Per-object upright left/base supported/velocity small/no hand AND release-ready. Release-ready: first sustained opposed grasp to final touch span3.6-5.8s white,3.3-5.4s black; reference-initialized preplaced objects exempt during curriculum.

reward_terms.name: milestones
reward_terms.formula: First settled/release-ready+8; first bottom>1cm+2; one-off-20 for first supporting table contact on right after an upright-air sample. One-off-20 if bottom>5mm or rotation from actual initial orientation>10deg before100ms stable opposed grasp during active phase; stable grasp flag latches once achieved.

reward_terms.name: action_smoothness
reward_terms.formula: -.02sum(filtered_action²/group_size)-.03sum(action_change²/group_size); legacy29 and extra15 each separately normalized.

reward_terms.name: joint_speed
reward_terms.formula: -mean((qd/(.8*published_speed))^4)

reward_terms.name: ordered_rest
reward_terms.formula: Before white first settled:-2min(4,relu(blackXYdrift-.005)/.01); active plug:-2clip((y-.13)/.04,0,1)*relu(blade_tilt-.34906585), no tilt upper cap.

reward_terms.name: penetration
reward_terms.formula: -min(4,(max_[redacted]-.003)^2/.003^2) above3mm

reward_terms.name: terminal
reward_terms.formula: -20000 hardware violation;-25 drop/nonfinite;-100 timeout without stable goal;+20000 both settled/release-ready continuously1.6s AND no hardware/drop/nonfinite and maximum physical penetration<=3mm. Full criteria independently checked.

reward_terms.name: object_position
reward_terms.formula: sum_o weight*exp(-||p-p_ref||^2/0.035^2); weight2 active,.35 otherwise During blackaugmentation, physical reference target adds[0,-shift_y,lift_z]. reward_terms.name: object_axis
reward_terms.formula: Active:2.5*(clip(dot(actual blade axis,reference blade axis),-1,1)+1)/2+2exp(-angle²/.35²); inactive:.15exp(-angle²/.5²). Blacktracking target is transformed by the same current fixed-reference frame in25; humanwrist reward remains physical/untransformed.

reward_terms.name: wrist_tracking
reward_terms.formula: Physical wrist to unchanged human wrist arrays, with fixed training phase map declared in sim15. Black:.45exp(-position_error²/.055²)+.45exp(-SO3_error²/.45²)-min(4,3(relu(position_error-.08)/.03)²)-min(4,2(relu(SO3_error-1.0471975512)/.3)²). White:1.5exp(-position_error²/.055²)+1.5exp(-SO3_error²/.45²)-min(4,8(relu(position_error-.055)/.03)²)-min(4,4(relu(SO3_error-.70)/.3)²).

reward_terms.name: finger_tracking
reward_terms.formula: exp(-mean(q-q_ref)^2/.16)

reward_terms.name: opposed_contact
reward_terms.formula: Active:0.6 positional opposition else0.1 any hand;0.8 balanced force/0.6N with opposed normals;0.4exp(-pad-bodySDF^2/.02^2) each thumb/index/middle. Before supported upright left, add0.8*clip(min(three normal forces)/.3N)*clip(norm(cross(index-thumb,middle-thumb))/.0004m2), with opposition and three contacts. Once supported upright left, replace accumulated contact term by0.15*term-0.6*sum(three normal forces)+0.4 anyhand before release-due or-0.4 anyhand after. Always subtract0.15sum min(10,relu(force-4N)). Supported-before-release-due: add max_over_thumb,index,middle exp(-((bodySDF(padskin)-.0015)/.01)^2) to encourage gentle last contact. Release-ready additionally needs phase>=205 white or>=373 black. Release-due requires phase>=205white/373black and span>=3.6white/3.3black, without upper bound. Actual settled/milestone/terminal eligibility retains upper duration bounds through release-ready.

reward_terms.name: lift_height
reward_terms.formula: Active phase100<=f<155white or280<=f<360black:2clip(bottom/(.015white,.035black),0,1)*(.3+.7exp(-tilt²/.45²)); after interval if left:exp(-bottom²/.005²)exp(-tilt²/.3²). Also active during black augmentation re-lift/carry stages2/3.

reward_terms.name: settled
reward_terms.formula: Per-object upright left/base supported/velocity small/no hand AND release-ready. Release-ready: first sustained opposed grasp to final touch span3.6-5.8s white,3.3-5.4s black; reference-initialized preplaced objects exempt during curriculum.

reward_terms.name: milestones
reward_terms.formula: First settled/release-ready+8; first bottom>1cm+2; one-off-20 for first supporting table contact on right after an upright-air sample. One-off-20 if bottom>5mm or rotation from actual initial orientation>10deg before100ms stable opposed grasp during active phase; stable grasp flag latches once achieved.

reward_terms.name: action_smoothness
reward_terms.formula: -.02sum(filtered_action²/group_size)-.03sum(action_change²/group_size); legacy29 and extra15 each separately normalized.

reward_terms.name: joint_speed
reward_terms.formula: -mean((qd/(.8*published_speed))^4)

reward_terms.name: ordered_rest
reward_terms.formula: Before white first settled:-2min(4,relu(blackXYdrift-.005)/.01); active plug:-2clip((y-.13)/.04,0,1)*relu(blade_tilt-.34906585), no tilt upper cap.

reward_terms.name: penetration
reward_terms.formula: -min(4,(max_[redacted]-.003)^2/.003^2) above3mm

reward_terms.name: terminal
reward_terms.formula: -20000 hardware violation;-25 drop/nonfinite;-100 timeout without stable goal;+20000 both settled/release-ready continuously1.6s AND no hardware/drop/nonfinite and maximum physical penetration<=3mm. Full criteria independently checked.

reward_terms.name: airborne_black_opposition_penalty
reward_terms.formula: -100 each50Hz training step when physical black bottom clearance>5mm and opposed thumb/index-or-middle contact is absent. Added to opposed_contact curve; reward-only privileged label, never actor input.

reward_terms.name: object_axis
reward_terms.formula: Active:2.5*(clip(dot(actual blade axis,reference blade axis),-1,1)+1)/2+2exp(-angle²/.35²); inactive:.15exp(-angle²/.5²). Blacktracking target is transformed by the same current fixed-reference frame in25; humanwrist reward remains physical/untransformed.

reward_terms.name: wrist_tracking
reward_terms.formula: Physical wrist to unchanged human wrist arrays, with fixed training phase map declared in sim15. Black:.45exp(-position_error²/.055²)+.45exp(-SO3_error²/.45²)-min(4,3(relu(position_error-.08)/.03)²)-min(4,2(relu(SO3_error-1.0471975512)/.3)²). White:1.5exp(-position_error²/.055²)+1.5exp(-SO3_error²/.45²)-min(4,8(relu(position_error-.055)/.03)²)-min(4,4(relu(SO3_error-.70)/.3)²).

reward_terms.name: finger_tracking
reward_terms.formula: exp(-mean(q-q_ref)^2/.16)

reward_terms.name: opposed_contact
reward_terms.formula: Active:0.6 positional opposition else0.1 any hand;0.8 balanced force/0.6N with opposed normals;0.4exp(-pad-bodySDF^2/.02^2) each thumb/index/middle. Before supported upright left, add0.8*clip(min(three normal forces)/.3N)*clip(norm(cross(index-thumb,middle-thumb))/.0004m2), with opposition and three contacts. Once supported upright left, replace accumulated contact term by0.15*term-0.6*sum(three normal forces)+0.4 anyhand before release-due or-0.4 anyhand after. Always subtract0.15sum min(10,relu(force-4N)). Supported-before-release-due: add max_over_thumb,index,middle exp(-((bodySDF(padskin)-.0015)/.01)^2) to encourage gentle last contact. Release-ready additionally needs phase>=205 white or>=373 black. Release-due requires phase>=205white/373black and span>=3.6white/3.3black, without upper bound. Actual settled/milestone/terminal eligibility retains upper duration bounds through release-ready.

reward_terms.name: lift_height
reward_terms.formula: Active phase100<=f<155white or280<=f<360black:2clip(bottom/(.015white,.035black),0,1)*(.3+.7exp(-tilt²/.45²)); after interval if left:exp(-bottom²/.005²)exp(-tilt²/.3²). Also active during black augmentation re-lift/carry stages2/3.

reward_terms.name: settled
reward_terms.formula: Per-object upright left/base supported/velocity small/no hand AND release-ready. Release-ready: first sustained opposed grasp to final touch span3.6-5.8s white,3.3-5.4s black; reference-initialized preplaced objects exempt during curriculum.

reward_terms.name: milestones
reward_terms.formula: First settled/release-ready+8; first bottom>1cm+2; one-off-20 for first supporting table contact on right after an upright-air sample. One-off-20 if bottom>5mm or rotation from actual initial orientation>10deg before100ms stable opposed grasp during active phase; stable grasp flag latches once achieved.

reward_terms.name: action_smoothness
reward_terms.formula: -.02sum(filtered_action²/group_size)-.03sum(action_change²/group_size); legacy29 and extra15 each separately normalized.

reward_terms.name: joint_speed
reward_terms.formula: -mean((qd/(.8*published_speed))^4)

reward_terms.name: ordered_rest
reward_terms.formula: Before white first settled:-2min(4,relu(blackXYdrift-.005)/.01); active plug:-2clip((y-.13)/.04,0,1)*relu(blade_tilt-.34906585), no tilt upper cap.

reward_terms.name: penetration
reward_terms.formula: -min(4,(max_[redacted]-.003)^2/.003^2) above3mm

reward_terms.name: terminal
reward_terms.formula: -20000 hardware violation;-25 drop/nonfinite;-100 timeout without stable goal;+20000 both settled/release-ready continuously1.6s AND no hardware/drop/nonfinite and maximum physical penetration<=3mm. Full criteria independently checked.

reward_terms.name: opposed_contact
reward_terms.formula: Active:0.6 positional opposition else0.1 any hand;0.8 balanced force/0.6N with opposed normals;0.4exp(-pad-bodySDF^2/.02^2) each thumb/index/middle. Before supported upright left, add0.8*clip(min(three normal forces)/.3N)*clip(norm(cross(index-thumb,middle-thumb))/.0004m2), with opposition and three contacts. Once supported upright left, replace accumulated contact term by0.15*term-0.6*sum(three normal forces)+0.4 anyhand before release-due or-0.4 anyhand after. Always subtract0.15sum min(10,relu(force-4N)). Supported-before-release-due: add max_over_thumb,index,middle exp(-((bodySDF(padskin)-.0015)/.01)^2) to encourage gentle last contact. Release-ready additionally needs phase>=205 white or>=373 black. Release-due requires phase>=205white/373black and span>=3.6white/3.3black, without upper bound. Actual settled/milestone/terminal eligibility retains upper duration bounds through release-ready.
